trace_function: trace a Python function with example inputs and return an optimized TorchScript ScriptFunction
trace_module: trace a PyTorch nn.Module and return a ScriptModule with the traced forward method
trace_module_methods: trace multiple methods of a PyTorch nn.Module by passing a dict of method names to example inputs
verify_jit_model: verify that a JIT compiled model produces the same outputs and gradients as its uncompiled version
get_trace_graph: get the traced execution graph and original return value of a function or module for ONNX export
